structural_constraints.release_family: OperatorRevision bound_to_release PackageRelease must have the same Package reached through revision_of Operator belongs_to_package.
structural_constraints.port_ownership: Every InputPort and OutputPort belongs to exactly one OperatorRevision; output lineage inputs belong to that same operator revision.
structural_constraints.source_binding: EvidenceSpan span_in_revision must equal the SourceRevision of its span_in_artifact SourceArtifact.
structural_constraints.property_cardinality: Required properties are present once; arrays have the declared value shape; required_links override a general 0..* link minimum to at least one for that class. Link cardinality 1 remains exactly one.
structural_constraints.scope_payload: ApplicabilityScope requires id, scope_status, combination and qualifiers. Reject unknown with known context; combination is preserved; scope context changes require a new ID. See scope_policy.shared_scope_contract.
structural_constraints.parameter_ownership: ParameterDefinition references an Operator; the subject OperatorRevision must implement that Operator and include the parameter in its declared revision-specific parameter set.
structural_constraints.numeric_constraints: Validate finite typed bounds per field and explicit unit, reject empty intersections; no implicit unit conversion or guessed thresholds.
structural_constraints.requirement_targets: At least one requires_constraint or requires_reference target. Representation-only, reference-only, and mixed targets are allowed; ALL_OF/ANY_OF apply across the whole target set. Reference targets must be ReferenceArtifactRevision with valid revision_of ReferenceArtifact and immutable content_hash.
structural_constraints.activation: Requirement.strength and when are orthogonal. activation_status explicitly distinguishes specified/unconditional/unknown; unknown does not satisfy an activation check.
